s0.ru: Рычаг в равновесии. Слева груз {m1} кг на плече {d1} м, правое плечо {d2} м. Найдите массу справа, в килограммах.
s0.en: A lever is balanced. A load of {m1} kg sits {d1} m to the left of the fulcrum, and the right arm is {d2} m. Find the mass on the right, in kilograms.

s1.en: A lever is balanced. A load of {m1} kg sits {d1} m to the left of the fulcrum, and a load of {m2} kg sits on the right. Find the right arm, in meters.
